# Registry commands

## brp registry schema

Fetch the Bevy type-registry schema (optionally crate-filtered)

```text
Fetch the Bevy type-registry schema (optionally crate-filtered)

Usage: bevy_copilot brp registry schema [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --host <HOST>
          Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --with-crates <WITH_CRATES>
          Only include types from these crates
      --port <PORT>
          Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --without-crates <WITHOUT_CRATES>
          Exclude types from these crates
      --compact <COMPACT>
          Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
      --type-limit <TYPE_LIMIT>
          Maximum number of types to return
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_registry_schema`
